object: Keycaps are sold in replacement sets, PBT is harder and long-wearing, and doubleshot legends do not fade even as a keycap wears.

object: Keycaps are replaceable wear items, PBT is described as harder and long-wearing, and doubleshot legends cannot fade or be removed even as the keycap wears. These facts can reduce legend-wear risk but do not establish switch, cable, socket, controller, or PCB longevity.

accepted_phrases: Keycaps can be replaced; PBT is harder and long-wearing; and doubleshot legends do not fade even as caps wear, so legend wear is separable from whole-board failure.

object: Metal contacts can be protected against oxidation, processors debounce contact oscillation, and hot-swap sockets let switches be replaced without normal soldering. These generic mechanisms describe switch and socket boundaries; they do not establish a complete keyboard's lifetime or make its PCB replaceable.
subject: keyboard switch and hot-swap mechanisms

accepted_phrases: Keyboard mechanisms explain metal-contact oxidation protection, debounce, and switch replacement through hot-swap sockets, but none of those generic facts proves whole-board longevity or PCB serviceability.

object: Seller claims about 50-million-cycle switches are physically plausible component claims, but generic mechanisms and the Sun68 PCB failure show that sockets, controller or PCB, cable, and other components remain independent failure paths. A switch number cannot be promoted to a ten-year complete-keyboard guarantee.

object: The Punkston is the cheapest and has the strongest displayed aggregate among the three, but only seller-level switch-cycle and keycap claims. The CODE V3 adds a detachable cable and a similar 50-million-cycle switch claim at the highest price without captured hot-swap wording. The RK100 has the lowest aggregate but the broadest stated replacement path through MX-compatible hot swapping, four spare switches, PBT keycaps, and an included cable.

object: Visible shine on the four-year NYM96 is compatible with continued board use. Replacement sets, PBT wear properties, and doubleshot legends separate cosmetic or legend wear from electronics failure. Product keycap claims therefore affect a replaceable wear item and cannot establish complete-board lifespan.
subject: keycap shine and legend durability

object: The snapshot contains individual 11-year Unicomp, almost-four-year NYM96, and approximately 15-year-old secondhand Logitech G15 observations. The Unicomp thread also includes failures and support complaints at very different ages. Together they show that long service is possible and that outcomes vary, but they do not yield a model failure rate or prove any current shopping listing will last a decade.
